summary.name: Insomnia
summary.one_liner: Insomnia is an open-source, AI-native API development platform (by Kong) for testing, debugging, designing, and mocking HTTP, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, SOAP, and WebSocket APIs, including MCP servers.
use_cases: testing and debugging REST and GraphQL APIs
running automated API test collections in CI/CD
syncing API definitions from Kong Konnect
summary.what_it_does: Insomnia is a collaborative API client and platform that supports HTTP, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, SOAP, WebSockets, Socket.io, SSE, and MCP servers. It lets users design APIs starting from OpenAPI specs with live preview, and generate mocks manually or from collections, specs, responses, or plain-language descriptions. Users can run unlimited collection tests with pre- and post-request scripting. Storage can be local, Git-based, or cloud-based, with optional end-to-end encryption for cloud sync. The Inso CLI validates and lints OpenAPI specs in Git pipelines and can push approved specs to Kong Gateway and related targets.
notable: Open-source with a free tier including Git sync for 3, unlimited projects, and unlimited collection runner
Native Kong Konnect integration to sync API catalog as source of truth
Built-in MCP client to inspect tools, resources, and prompts and log MCP auth events
caveats: Paid enterprise features such as SSO/SAML, SCIM, data locality policies, and enterprise SLAs are part of higher tiers; exact pricing not stated on the page
Platform list on page mentions 'NSIS' and 'Others' without detail; Linux is not explicitly named on the page
